text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wow, way to kill the mood!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I mean, usually you'd be more... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait... You seem kinda down in the
dumps...
Something happen?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Figured you'd say that! But
unfortunately for
you, I can't just leave
you alone now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead... lay it on me. If there's
something I
can do for you, I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...The school store ran out of yakisoba
dogs.
